title: Betrayal Legacy
subtitle: A multi-generational legacy horror chronicle shaping an infamous haunted estate
tagline: Generations will perish, but the house always remembers
loreSummary: You represent rival families tied across centuries to a cursed mansion in the Massachusetts woods. Over fourteen haunting chapters spanning from 1666 to 2004, your deeds, heirlooms, and deaths permanently carve the dark history of the House on the Hill.
roadmapTitle: 🏚️ Ancestral Chronicle & Decades of the House
keyFeatures: Multi-generational campaign tracking family bloodlines across 338 years
Heirloom creation permanently bonding items and powers to family lineages
Evolving mansion layout with persistent stickers, sealed rooms, and custom tiles
The Bleak Journal narrative system triggering dynamic hauntings each era

betrayal_campaign.name: The 14-Session Chronicle
betrayal_campaign.description: The complete ancestral legacy campaign from the 1666 Prologue through 13 generational chapters to the 2004 grand finale.

betrayal_extended.name: Campaign & Free-Play Haunts
betrayal_extended.description: The full 14-chapter campaign followed by 6 post-campaign sessions exploring the permanently personalized mansion in Free Play mode.

betrayal_completionist.name: Grand Estate Explorations
betrayal_completionist.description: The complete campaign plus 12 post-campaign haunts to discover untapped room tiles, unrevealed items, and alternate haunt scenarios.

milestones.title: The Founding Gathering
milestones.description: Five colonial families seek shelter in an isolated homestead, unknowingly awakening a persistent evil in the soil.

milestones.title: Colonial Bloodlines
milestones.description: Descendants inherit family heirlooms and darkest deeds as new rooms expand over the tainted ground.

milestones.title: The Victorian Descent
milestones.description: Industrial prosperity masks the sinister decay of the manor as spectral corridors entrap another generation.

milestones.title: The Modern Reckoning
milestones.description: The surviving bloodlines confront centuries of accumulated horrors in the definitive final haunt of the House on the Hill.
